Callout.Name: Diesel Stolen from a Tank
Callout.Message: Fuel tank drained on a farm overnight.
Callout.Advisory: No suspects, siphon marks at the tank.

Script.Line: They drilled the tank. That is a proper job, that is not children.
Six hundred litres. That needs a trailer and a pump.
There are tracks running out to the road and they are fresh.

Lines.Approach: They have had the whole tank away. Owner is more annoyed than anything.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
